verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents selecting multiple conversations and applying archive, label, or done to them in one action. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: the homepage line "Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest" describes an AI-driven sweep, not user multi-select. AI filters that auto-label or archive are rule-based automation, and community praise for Bundles, 'mark as done', and fast inbox clearing never mentions bulk selection.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
